text: すこし　なついてきた　のね　しんらいが　うまれて　きたみたい

structure.jp: なついてきた　のね
うまれて　きたみたい

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: てくる says a change has gradually come about up to now. なついてきた = 'has come to be attached'.

patterns.name: 〜みたい
patterns.explanation: みたい says 'it seems'. うまれて　きたみたい = 'it seems to be forming'.
